children: Bitcoin Cash's Faster Blocks upgrade is scheduled for lock-in on November 15, 2026, targeting a block time of one minute. The Knuth node team says it is on track for the milestone.
The proposed change concerns the interval between blocks on the Bitcoin Cash network. Testing continues, so the effect on BCH depends on Faster Blocks reaching its scheduled lock-in milestone.
Knuth is on track for the Nov 15 lock-in of Faster Blocks - 1-minute Bitcoin Cash blocks. ⏱️
Things are moving faster and faster on Bitcoin Cash ⚡️

title: Bitcoin Cash: Faster Blocks targets lock-in for one-minute blocks - 15 Nov 2026
